name: check_task
description: Read the environment-owned official task result from current public state. Use when: verifying possible completion from actual evidence or confirming the required success latch before finishing. Effect: read-only; no simulation step or robot mutation. Returns: success and task_success Boolean when the checker is available, otherwise an unavailable reason and retryable state. Does not: reveal the predicate, hidden object states or a solution, and unavailable is not a measured false verdict. On error: wait for a valid current observation; do not substitute motion arrival or your own judgment for the checker.
